timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is Nathan Vanloon. I've represented a thousand children in family court.

When Nathan represented my family during a critical time, he was kind and professional.
Not only did he get us through it, he got us our granddaughter.

They changed all that for us.
My name is Nathan Vanloon and I approve this message.
I'm going to defend the children of Monroe County.

Vote Nathan Van Loon for Monroe County Family Court Judge on November 5th!
Nathan is endorsed by the Monroe County Democratic Committee and the Monroe County Independence Party.
For more information head to www.electvanloon.com, or the Facebook page at https://www.facebook.com/nathanvanloonforfamilycourt
